template<typename P>
inline uint4 ld4(P p) { return uint4(p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3]); }
idea: k002's 16-byte-per-lane loads with only 2 rows per simdgroup and 128-thread threadgroups, to cut register pressure and raise occupancy, with weight/scale/bias loads issued before the x pre-scaling math.
